Priya (Growth): Flagging something odd on this week's KPI board — Paid acquisition conversions are +18% in the ads dashboard but our central KPI board shows only +2%. Can someone sanity-check? :thinking_face:
dash-bot: Daily KPIs updated (snapshot 2060014000). Sources: ads, crm, web.
Evan (Data): Two quick things to check: attribution window mismatch (ads uses 7d click, KPIs currently set to 24h last-touch) and timezone/cohort alignment. ran a quick crosswalk: 24h window captures ~60% of the conversions the 7d window does.
Avi (Paid): Ads partner did a gated creative test Tue-Thu which increased late conversions (day 2-4). We report 7d click typically. Did the KPI config change?
Sophie  Comms: Ugh that explains why the narrative looks conservative in the readout. We already drafted comms saying "steady week" — will wait for final numbers before posting.
Evan (Data): Also noticed deduping differences: ad platform reports lead events grouped by click_id, our CRM dedupes by email. If a user clicks multiple creatives then converts once, platform count > CRM. Need a canonical dedupe rule for the KPI board.
Priya (Growth): Can we add an annotation to the KPI board showing "attribution window: 24h vs ads 7d; dedupe method: CRM email" so PMs and GTM don't misinterpret?
Evan (Data): Yep. I'll add header note and compute a "7d-aligned" column for this week so you can see adjusted numbers. I'll also push a small reconciliation table to the dashboard: `ads_7d -> raw`, `crm_dedupe -> canonical`.
Avi (Paid): Do we want to standardize on 7d for launch weeks? Historically we use 7d for paid and 24h for organic. Might make sense to surface both columns always.
Sophie  Comms: Surface both please. We need to decide quickly because press snippets pull from the board.
Evan (Data): On it. Recalc running (job 2060014305). ETA ~6m. I'll paste deltas when ready.
dash-bot: Recalc job queued: ad_kpi_align (2060014305).
Evan (Data): Recalc done. Key delta: paid conversions +14 (7d) vs canonical 24h. Percent delta is +15% for the week. Updated board with two columns and a hover note about dedupe logic.
Priya (Growth): Perfect — that squares with the ads dashboard now. Action items: 1) Evan keep both columns visible for launch weeks, 2) Avi confirm partner reporting window in weekly notes, 3) Sophie hold comms until we confirm column to quote.
Avi (Paid): I'll add the partner reporting window to the ad weekly doc.
Sophie  Comms: Pausing the Slack announcement until you confirm which column we'll quote.
Priya (Growth): Thanks team. Closing this thread once comms go live. :white_check_mark:
